title: Forbidden
description: The mistress (Barbara Stanwyck) of a lawyer (Adolphe Menjou) running for governor marries an editor (Ralph Bellamy), who finds she has a baby.

title: The Collector
description: A British butterfly collector kidnaps an art student, Miranda Grey, and keeps her in his farmhouse cellar.

title: The Three Stooges in Orbit
description: Three men get mixed up with some Martian spies' invention.

title: Berserk
description: Scotland Yard looks into spiking, buzz sawing and knifing at ringmaster Monica's traveling circus.

title: Bell, Book and Candle
description: A witch's (Kim Novak) warlock brother (Jack Lemmon) helps a San Francisco publisher (James Stewart) break a love spell.

title: In Cold Blood
description: Two ex-convicts (Robert Blake, Scott Wilson) are tried for the savage killing of a farm family in 1959 Kansas.

title: Anatomy of a Murder
description: A Michigan lawyer (James Stewart) and his colleague defend an Army lieutenant (Ben Gazzara) who killed the man who raped the officer's wife (Lee Remick).

title: The Big Heat
description: When his investigation into a corrupt cop's suicide spawns a car bombing that takes the life of his wife, Police Sergeant Dave Bannion quits the force to pursue the case on his own.

title: Murderers' Row
description: A secret agent blocks a villain's helio-beam plot in the second of four Matt Helm movies.

title: All Ashore
description: Three sailors celebrate their shore leave in grand style by taking off on a spree to Catalina Island.

title: A Night to Remember
description: A mystery writer and his wife find a corpse in the backyard of their Greenwich Village apartment.

title: The Taming of the Shrew
description: Shakespeare's Petruchio weds Katharina on his own terms in Padua.

title: Sahara
description: An Army sergeant (Humphrey Bogart), his tank crew (Bruce Bennett, Dan Duryea) and stragglers hold off a Nazi battalion at a waterhole.

title: Mickey One
description: A nightclub comic (Warren Beatty) in debt to mobsters hides in Chicago at the mercy of his ego.

title: The Silencers
description: A secret agent (Dean Martin) stops a Chinese villain's atomic plot in the first of four Matt Helm movies.

title: Theodora Goes Wild
description: A small-town New England author (Irene Dunne) meets her racy novel's urbane illustrator (Melvyn Douglas) in Manhattan.

title: Cactus Flower
description: A dentist (Walter Matthau) has his prim assistant (Ingrid Bergman) pose as his wife to discourage his kooky girlfriend (Goldie Hawn).

title: Anatomy of a Murder
description: A Michigan lawyer (James Stewart) and his colleague defend an Army lieutenant (Ben Gazzara) who killed the man who raped the officer's wife (Lee Remick).

title: Easy Rider
description: Two free spirits (Peter Fonda, Dennis Hopper) on chopped motorcycles clash with the Establishment and meet a boozy lawyer (Jack Nicholson) as they cross America.

title: Cat Ballou
description: When an outlaw (Lee Marvin) with a fake nose kills her father, a schoolmarm (Jane Fonda) hires his drunken twin to get revenge.

title: Born Yesterday
description: A scrap-metal tycoon (Broderick Crawford) pays a Washington newsman (William Holden) to make his girlfriend (Judy Holliday) couth.

title: Diamond Head
description: The head (Charlton Heston) of a Hawaiian pineapple dynasty refuses to let his sister (Yvette Mimieux) marry a native.

title: Tight Spot
description: A detective (Brian Keith) guards a brassy blonde (Ginger Rogers) freed from prison to be a federal prosecutor's (Edward G. Robinson) key mob witness.

title: Boots Malone
description: Has-been agent Boots Malone (William Holden) is dodging his creditors and living on the edge of the horse racing world when wealthy teenager Tommy Gibson (Johnny Stewart) asks Malone to take him under his wing as a jockey-in-training.

title: Salome
description: A dancing princess (Rita Hayworth) loves a Roman commander (Stewart Granger) and inspires King Herod (Charles Laughton) to have John the Baptist beheaded.

title: The Awful Truth
description: Spouses (Irene Dunne, Cary Grant) try to spoil each other's chances for romance before their divorce becomes final in 90 days.

title: Port Afrique
description: An American (Phil Carey) returns to Morocco and discovers his wife's past while probing her death.

title: Fire Down Below
description: A woman (Rita Hayworth) without a passport divides West Indies smugglers (Robert Mitchum, Jack Lemmon), then a fire threatens to sink a freighter.

title: You Can't Run Away From It
description: A newsman (Jack Lemmon) rides a bus, hitchhikes and shares a cabin with a tycoon's (Charles Bickford) runaway daughter (June Allyson).

title: It Happened One Night
description: A newsman (Clark Gable) rides a bus and shares a cabin with a tycoon's (Walter Connolly) runaway daughter (Claudette Colbert).

title: Hot Blood
description: A Gypsy king (Luther Adler) tricks his brother (Cornel Wilde) in Los Angeles into marrying a Roma bride (Jane Russell) that he bought.

title: Our Wife
description: A composer (Melvyn Douglas) goes on a cruise and meets a woman (Ruth Hussey) he likes more than his wife (Ellen Drew).

title: The Undercover Man
description: Two Treasury agents (Glenn Ford, James Whitmore) set out to nail a mobster for tax evasion.

title: Boston Blackie and the Law
description: Reformed thief Blackie (Chester Morris) does a magic show in a women's prison, during which an inmate escapes.

title: It Happened to Jane
description: A Maine lobsterwoman (Doris Day) has her lawyer (Jack Lemmon) sue a railroad tycoon (Ernie Kovacs) over a spoiled shipment.

title: Her Husband's Affairs
description: A wacky woman (Lucille Ball) somehow gets the credit for her husband's (Franchot Tone) advertising genius.

title: Gidget Goes to Rome
description: Teenage Gidget (Cindy Carol) and boyfriend Moondoggie (James Darren) cause romantic confusion on vacation in Italy.

title: You Were Never Lovelier
description: A tycoon (Adolphe Menjou) sends anonymous gifts to his daughter (Rita Hayworth) to make her fall for a mystery man he will choose later, but a dancer (Fred Astaire) he doesn't like takes the credit.

title: You Can't Take It With You
description: An eccentric patriarch meets the stuffy parents of his granddaughter's fiancé.

title: It Had to Be You
description: A marriage-shy sculptor (Ginger Rogers) meets the Indian boy of her childhood dreams, now a firefighter (Cornel Wilde).
